P2-A1.title: Engine phase 2: form, classification, affine boards, fates, root test, guards
P2-A1.summary: Every function marked phase 2 in SPEC 5.3 and 5.4: symmetrizer and gram with the normalisation min d_i = 1 per component; cartanClass by leading principal minors of B = DC; relabellings by the oracle's backtracking; identify with candidates in the order A, B, C, D, E, F, G; affineCandidates and identifyAffine; classify with records in the golden field names; smallestNonfiniteSubboard; affineExtension (node 0 first, untwisted or twisted via the highest short root); marks, comarks, level; spectralRadius by power iteration on A + I; boardFromName for affine, twisted, pentagon and square; playFate with loop detection; isRootPopulation by greedy descent with the 20000-step cap; coroot; formValue; formIsInvariant with a witness; the guards of E-11 with a WeakMap cache; the golden tests of phase 2 and property tests 5, 10, 13 and the second half of 7.
spec: 5.1 E-7 (labels of affine boards), E-8, E-10, E-11
5.5 (Matching two boards; Finite, affine or neither; Naming; Smallest non-finite sub-board; Spectral radius; Root test; Fates)
Appendix G (affine, twisted_affine, affine_names, classification_tests, pentagon_example, kostant.affine_board_from_node)
owns: packages/engine/src/classify.ts, affine.ts, form.ts, guards.ts, board.ts (boardFromName additions), play.ts (playFate), index.ts (exports)
deliverables: symmetrizer: d_i by walking a spanning tree per component, then d_i C_ij = d_j C_ji checked on every pair; null when it fails; normalised min 1 per component; gram B = DC as rationals
cartanClass on a connected gcm board: not balanced → indefinite; else leading principal minors of B exactly with rationals; finite / affine / indefinite as 2.12; NeedsConnectedBoard, NeedsTwoWayRoads

relabellings exactly as the oracle (signature filter; placement order next to placed nodes; lexicographic output; limit); identify trying A, B, C, D, E, F, G so rank 2 is B2; order[k] = position playing Bourbaki node k+1, lexicographically smallest
affineCandidates(m) from the oracle's list (the affine board of B2 appears once as C2~; twisted names A_{2n}^{(2)}, A_{2n-1}^{(2)}, D_{n+1}^{(2)}, E_6^{(2)}, D_4^{(3)}); identifyAffine
classify: one ClassifyRecord per component with golden field names and positions; one-way components with kind one-way, class null, balanced false, name null; NotABoard on a not-a-board matrix
smallestNonfiniteSubboard: subsets by size then lexicographic, first connected non-finite; null on finite boards and one-way boards

affineExtension(board, short): node 0 first with C_0j = -<theta^vee, alpha_j> and C_j0 = -<alpha_j^vee, theta>; theta the highest root or the highest short root; marks and comarks; NotFiniteType and NeedsTwoWayRoads; the Kostant recipe equivalence tested against kostant[*].affine_board_from_node
nullVector, marks (C delta = 0), comarks (c^T C = 0), level; NotAffine with the class in the message on every other board
spectralRadius: power iteration on A + I from the normalised all-ones vector, stop at 1e-13 or 5000 steps, minus 1; null on one-way
boardFromName additions: X~ for every finite type (B2~ and C2~ both accepted, both the affine extension of their numbering), twisted names, pentagon and square; all Board<bigint> with labels per E-7
playFate: ended, looped at the first repeat, cap; firstVisit
isRootPopulation: gcm only; negate if any entry negative; greedy descent at the lowest positive number; false when stuck or an entry goes negative; null after cap steps (default 20000)
coroot (b_i d_i / (beta,beta)/2 as integers), formValue (Rational, null when not balanced), formIsInvariant with the witness of form_invariance_witness

guards.ts: classify verdict cached in a WeakMap keyed by board object; requireGcm / requireConnected / requireFinite / requireAffine applied to every function of the finite theory of phases 1 and 2 per the table of 5.6 (the phase-1 functions gain their guards here)

golden tests for every key listed; classification_tests reproduced field by field including bourbaki_order, marks, comarks, smallest_nonfinite_subboard and spectral_radius_4_decimals as text; affine_names from affineCandidates(m) for m = 2..9; twisted_affine including least_k_with_e_x_plus_k_delta_a_root and reverse_of; pentagon_example word, fired, end, moves, level under the lowest-node rule

properties 5 (formValue unchanged by mutate), 7 second half (isRootPopulation accepts every root and rejects its double), 10 (level unchanged by fire; mutate fixes the marks on the affine board of each type), 13 (classify of a randomly renumbered finite or affine board returns the same name and bourbaki_order restores the standard matrix)

labels-affine.test.ts: classify, smallestNonfiniteSubboard and admissibility-style records return positions, and converting with toLabels on an affine board yields labels starting at 0 (the E-7 check SPEC 5.1 asks for)
acceptance: GOLDEN_KEYS_BY_PHASE[2] covered and passing (G2)
properties 5, 7b, 10, 13 passing
every row of the table in SPEC 5.6 reproduced by guards.test.ts (one-way board and non-finite gcm board, for every function group)
identify recognises every type under random relabelling, naming the rank-2 board B2 and its affine board C2~
traps: cartanClass uses the leading principal minors of B = DC, not of C; the definition by all principal minors is the oracle's cross-check only.
relabellings must return p with C1[p[i]][p[j]] = C2[i][j]: node i of the second board is node p[i] of the first.
A2^(2) has a 4 in the Cartan matrix (C = [[2,-4],[-1,2]]); the editor's road cap of 4 each way must still admit it.
marks of twisted boards differ from comarks; reversing roads exchanges them (2.12).

The guards of E-11 change the behaviour of phase-1 functions on non-finite boards: finite-theory functions throw NotFiniteType there, while mutate, fire, orbit, roots, play keep working. Update the phase-1 tests only by adding cases, never by weakening.
isRootPopulation on a one-way board throws NeedsTwoWayRoads; on the triangle e_1 + k delta takes 2k steps.

P2-A2.title: Tool T3 Form Finder
P2-A2.summary: Meter, builder and small values: the form value during play; the builder's weights with the invariance test and the engine's witness; the typed populations with form value and the root test; every acceptance criterion of SPEC 4 T3 as tests.
deliverables: meter: (p,p) during play on a linked T1; constant along play

builder: city weights w_i > 0 and road weights w_ij >= 0 defining Q_w; Test asks formIsInvariant and shows the witness population and mutation when it fails; passes exactly for w_i = 2 d_i, w_ij = 2 d_i A_ji up to scale
small values: typed populations with at most six digits per entry; form value and isRootPopulation verdict; 'too large to test here' on null

T03.test.ts: builder accepts the symmetrizer weights and rejects a perturbation of any one weight on A2, B2, B3, F4, G2; meter constant along 1000 random moves on each finite type; on the two unbalanced triangles 100 random positive weight choices all fail with a witness
T03.spec.ts: the A2 builder with three sliders passes exactly when all three are equal; a typed root population of A3 reads 2 and 'root population'; the digit cap
acceptance: every bullet of SPEC 4 T3 acceptance has a passing test (G2)
traps: Road weight w_ij = 2 d_i A_ji (with A_ji roads from j into i); on B2 the ratio of city weights is 2:1.
Entries of at most six digits: the field refuses more (5.6).

P2-A3.title: Tool T4 Classification Lab and the shared board editor
P2-A3.summary: The graph editor with a live verdict: BoardEditor.svelte (shared with T16) with up to 12 nodes, 0 to 4 roads each way including one-way roads, drag with button and key equivalents, renumbering on delete, presets; the verdict panel exactly as classify returns it with B2 = C2; balance and weights; spectral radius; the smallest non-finite sub-board; the root counter on the main thread then in the worker; the conjecture hunter; every acceptance criterion of SPEC 4 T4 as tests.
spec: 4.0 (Growth off the finite types; Stated limits; Board pickers; Test hooks; Small screens)
deliverables: BoardEditor.svelte: add and remove nodes (max 12) and roads (0 to 4 each way, one-way allowed) by buttons and keys as well as drag; drag to arrange on whole grid points 0..11; deleting a node renumbers 1..n in old order and resets start and moves; presets: every finite type, the affine boards of the golden data, the classification_tests boards; emits a BoardSpec with xy; keyboard and screen-reader operable

verdict per component exactly as classify returns it: finite with name and the Bourbaki matching; affine with name, marks, comarks; indefinite; 'has a one-way road: the theory does not apply'; B2 = C2 shown per D19
also shown: balanced and the d_i; spectral radius to four decimals on gcm boards; smallest non-finite sub-board when not finite

root counter: complete and immediate on finite boards; else main thread for layers or 2000 positions with the exact stop words, and 'keep counting' continuing in the worker to 100000; roads style on one-way boards
conjecture hunter: the first mixed-sign root population found, or 'none among the k root populations of the first 40 layers'

T04.test.ts: identification of every type and every affine and twisted board under random relabelling (B2 for C2, C2~ for the affine board of B2); every classification_tests entry reproduced; one-way road: (-1,1) after two moves and no finite or affine verdict; never a mixed population on bidirected boards (search over the test boards); star with five arms: 2000 with layers 0-10, then 100000 with layers 0-17 holding 74311 (the second via the worker path in a Node test harness or an e2e test)

T04.spec.ts: draw the triangle by keyboard only and read 'affine'; load the one-way preset and see roads style and the mixed population; 'keep counting' on the star with five arms reports the stop message; 320-pixel layout usable
acceptance: every bullet of SPEC 4 T4 acceptance has a passing test (G2)
no action is drag-only (A-8 test)
the worker is never fetched before 'keep counting' is pressed (worker-on-demand)
traps: 'not of finite type' only when classify says so; the counter's cap never implies it (4.0).
The editor refuses a 13th node and a 5th road each way (5.6); the engine accepts any count.
A2^(2) needs 4 roads one way; the editor must allow it.
The spectral radius is not shown on a one-way board.
classify is called once on load (5.6 last sentence).
